401873083.summary: Most analysts back Denver straight up, and the case got stronger overnight. Pittsburgh released Aaron Rodgers on Thursday after his comments about Mike McCarthy, so Mason Rudolph makes his first start of the season after one practice as the starter. The Steelers also ruled out edge Alex Highsmith, though Nick Herbig is cleared and WR Michael Pittman Jr. came off IR. Covers, Sports Betting Dime and numberFire (61%) back the Broncos (8-2, six straight wins), as do ESPN's Moody and Walder, and DraftKings Network takes Denver to lead at halftime and at the end. The dissent comes from SI Betting, CBS (both written before the release) and ESPN's Maldonado (Steelers 20-17), with ESPN FPI giving Pittsburgh 51.3%. The forecast is about 42F with a 65% chance of rain and gusts to 28 mph.
